preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and the restriction k on moving up satisfy 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 10^6.
The list p contains exactly n - 1 integers, where p_i is the parent of vertex i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: Each parent p_i is a valid vertex number between 1 and n.
The root vertex is 1, so p_2 (the parent of vertex 2) is 1.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of different leaves visited is between 0 and n.
The output is the maximum number of different leaves that can be visited during one sequence of moves.
